thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — onboarding customers who ingested embeddings in the last 24h are seeing mismatch scores and some 5xxs. We need a short status note + an invite for office hours. Who can own comms?
Tony Rivera: I'm on-call this morning, can draft the initial note. Do we have an affected list? :eyes:
Jordan Kim: I pulled a quick query — ~38 tenants with failed reindex jobs, ~12 with degraded similarity scoring. I'll DM the CSV to Maya and Lia.
Lia Patel: Thanks Jordan. Tony, if you draft I can tailor per-segment (high-touch vs self-serve). Also recommend we offer a 10% service credit for any impacted renewals in this window.
Sanjay Rao: Root cause so far: a hotfix deployment to the embeddings router introduced a cache-key regression when shard count changed. That led to stale KV lookups and some downstream 502/503s. Rollback completed at 09:12 UTC and traffic is back to normal for most routes.
Maya Chen: Good — please confirm percentage of traffic that hit the bad path and ETA for RCA. Also need a mitigation note for customers on Dedicated.
Sanjay Rao: ~18% of embed writes hit the bad path at peak. For Dedicated customers we pushed a config knob to bypass router-level cache; that restored write success for those pools by 09:30 UTC. Full RCA doc estimate: EOD.
Tony Rivera: Draft customer message (short):

---- copy start ----
Hi — we’re investigating an issue that impacted embeddings and similarity results for some customers between 08:40–09:12 UTC today. We’ve rolled back the deployment and restored full traffic. Our engineers are finishing an RCA and we’ll share next steps by end of day. If you saw failed reindex jobs or incorrect search results, reply here or join our office hours at 15:00 UTC.

We’re offering a one-time credit for affected usage; your CSM will follow up with details.
---- copy end ----

Jordan Kim: LGTM. Suggest adding link to status page and an incident ticket ID so we can track replies: INC-2026-3301
Lia Patel: Updated copy with ticket and status link: I added: "Track status at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-3301" and a line: "If you need immediate help, request 1:1 troubleshooting when you reply."
Maya Chen: Perfect. Tony, please send to the 38 affected tenants as a prioritized batch (high-touch first). Include the CSV Jordan DM'd.
Tony Rivera: Will do. I'll send high-touch pool now, then self-serve set in waves. Also scheduling office hours invite for 15:00 UTC — adding engineering leads (Sanjay + Jordan) and a notes doc.
Sanjay Rao: For the RCA: root cause is a regression in cache key namespace handling after shard-count autoscaling. Mitigation: revert, add unit test for key normalization, and add a canary route for router releases. Postmortem will include timeline and follow-ups (QA checks + deploy gating).
Maya Chen: Can we share a short FAQ with CS? Quick Qs: 1) Will embeddings need re-ingest? 2) Are model results permanently affected?
Sanjay Rao: Answers: 1) Some re-ingest required for items that failed during the window — we'll flag those keys in the failed-job CSV. 2) No permanent model drift; similarity scores may have been off for impacted objects until reindex completes.
Lia Patel: I'll draft the FAQ snippet and include re-ingest steps + a sample email templates for renewals teams.
Tony Rivera: Sending first batch now. Pasting confirmation: "High-touch batch (12 tenants) sent at 10:08 UTC — awaiting replies." :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3301 status changed to "monitoring" — next update scheduled for 15:30 UTC.
Maya Chen: Great work team. After office hours we'll consolidate customer asks and finalize the EOD RCA share. Assigning follow-ups: Tony — outbound comms; Lia — FAQ + renewal note; Jordan — affected CSV verification; Sanjay — RCA writeup. I'll own exec summary.
Lia Patel: Adding a short renewal bridge note: "If your contract renewal falls within 30 days and you were affected, we’ll proactively review credits and potential early renewal concessions. Please flag renewals in your reply."
Jordan Kim: CSV verification in progress — found 3 tenants that had partial ingest (some batches succeeded). I'll annotate and return by 12:00 UTC.
Tony Rivera: Noted. Will coordinate follow-up cadence with CSMs. If anyone sees urgent customer replies, ping me in DMs.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for comms drafts so we have an audit trail.

(Short, actionable replies only from here on — we'll keep threads minimal per agents.md guidelines)
